sec: Test VII: Essay / Short Answer (10 pts)
inst: Directions: Answer the following questions in 3 to 5 sentences each. Be concise, clear, and use proper technical terminology. Each item is worth 5 points.

qts.question: Explain the concept of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and briefly describe each of its four fundamental principles: Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, and Polymorphism. Give a real-world analogy for any one of the four principles.
Differentiate between a "for" loop, a "while" loop, and a "do-while" loop in C#. Describe a specific scenario or use case where each type of loop is the most appropriate choice, and explain why.
